claim: Electronic documents become interactive and nonlinear.
originalWording: Electronic documents become interactive and nonlinear.

sources.title: How My Predictions Are Faring — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: The Age of Intelligent Machines excerpts, printed pp. 124–126; original-book pp. 428–430

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Electronic documents support routine nonlinear navigation, linking and interaction.
reference.rationale: No precise deadline is established for this version; do not manufacture an on-time rate. The Web plainly fulfills the functional claim. CERN’s history establishes the 1990s realization; attribution novelty is distinct from whether the outcome occurred.

evidence.title: CERN: The birth of the Web
evidence.note: Web invention in 1989 and subsequent 1990s development. Realization is established; this does not prove it was wholly novel to a 1990 forecaster..
